_unit_warning: repositories_contributing_an_analysed_template is NOT the funnel's '182 repositories with runtimes'. The funnel counts repositories before test fixtures and forks are removed; this counts the repositories the 220 surviving templates come from. Do not use one label for the other.
note: The two units answer different questions and must never be mixed. A repository that is multi-agent only because several single-agent templates sit beside each other is a weaker observation than one template declaring several agents, because nothing says the templates are applied to one account. The shared-role finding is only computed within a template, so the repository unit carries no shared-role claim of its own.
